narratives.Description: security(authz): kill-switch plant guard regressed in #6580 (quoted launcher payload and xargs pipeline forms)
narratives.Overview:
Kill-switch plant guard regressed in #6580.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A shell launcher wrapper whose quoted payload redirects into the kill-switch file is refused again, as it was before #6580.
- [ ] A pipeline that feeds the kill-switch filename to a writer through xargs is refused again, as it was before #6580.
- [ ] The same pipeline shape aimed at the protected stores is refused.
- [ ] Every probe form that was denied before #6580 is still denied, pinned by regression tests in the authz classify and evaluate tests.

intended_placement.module_boundary: packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts keeps owning the shell-op classification and the kill-switch plant scan; the change widens what that scan sees (quoted launcher payloads, xargs pipelines). No new module; new tests go in classify.test.ts and evaluate.test.ts.
intended_placement.cohesion_exemption: packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts and its test files are the existing home of shell-op classification. The story adds a scoped scan inside the existing plant guard and test cases only; splitting those files is out of scope for a security hotfix.

expected_outputs: quoted launcher payload and xargs pipeline forms naming the kill-switch file or protected stores are denied again
